text.p: Perrigo Co said Tuesday its board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to 7,500,000 shares.
The purchases will be made in the open market or in private transactions over the next six to 24 months. Perrigo had 76,579,000 shares outstanding as of March 31.
The common stock repurchased under the program will be used for general corporate purposes and will be held in the company treasury.
Earlier, Perrigo reported third quarter earnings of $0.15 a share, up from $0.14 a year ago. Excluding restructuring and litigation costs in both periods, earnings were $0.18 a share, up from $0.15.

"We are pleased to see our over-the-counter pharmaceutical business record a double-digit sales increase again this quarter and for the nine months," Mike Jandernoa, chairman, said in a statement. "The increase in (over-the-counter) sales reflected a severe cough, cold and flu season that continued through much of our third quarter and contributed to sales increases in the cough and cold and analgesic categories."
Also strong in the quarter, he added, were antacid, vitamin and laxative products, as well as new products such as naproxen sodium, minoxidil and pregnancy test kits.
